# TITANTH
> TITANTH Catalog Check is a browser-based tool that checks a Shopify product CSV for the product identifiers the EU requires on consumer-parcel customs declarations from 1 November 2026 (merchant code, non-standardised manufacturer code, standardised barcode). It runs locally, does not upload data, and is sold as a one-time US$59 license per store. A free version checks the first 25 rows.

- https://titanth.com/guides/shopify-barcode-errors-eu-customs/ : barcode errors

## Facts
- Legal basis: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1022. Voluntary from 2026-07-01, mandatory from 2026-11-01.
- Not legal advice; not a customs filing service; no compliance certification.
